development_notes: Initial complete nine-module run: 527 tested, 390 caught, 105 unviable, 13 timeouts, 19 survivors. Investigated CLI enable/conversion, exact spool/bulk limits, refusal/IO accounting, CRLF allocation and byte-boundary Unicode labels.

Removed a redundant UTF-8 floor bound; verified UTF-8 and three-byte lookbehind guarantee the preceding boundary. HTTP query ranges are clamped/validated; internal InvalidRange read failures are 503, so removed the unnecessary 400 mapping.

Complete updated native main/spool/server scopes resolve their survivors. Complete projection scope resolves Unicode label gap. Complete final reader scope has one retained CRLF allocation-overgrowth survivor, resolved by the compact-bitset capacity test and two-mutant verified rerun.

Aggregate selects unchanged model/query/source/engine from the broad run, main/spool/server from their complete rerun, projection from complete core rerun, and the final complete reader with the two verified CRLF outcomes replacing corresponding entries. No duplicate outcomes.
Other overlapping development capture-function and source/module reruns are not summed. Final production bodies match recorded hashes; later changes were tests/orchestration.
limits: Caught counts are assertion/test-process failures; timeouts break progress and are separate. Unviable substitutions are build failures.
Complete affected production modules were exercised. Final reader/projection reruns use core tests; normal workspace/native HTTP/browser integration checks exercise the combined final implementation.

Dependency/grammar internals, serialization/hash macro bodies, optional benchmark orchestration, Python, allocator/filesystem internals, JS/CSS painting and browser internals are outside these native mutation scopes.
